t1.text: A book's Reading card with its Progress

n1.text:
Real books, checked on Open Library 2026-11-16.

Piranesi, Susanna Clarke: 272 pages (the median of its editions), so 142 of 272.
Kafka on the Shore: a page only, p. 88.
Ворошиловград, Сергій Жадан: no Progress yet.

The page count is the User's own edition, never Open Library's (spec #204).

Tweaks switches every board between dark and light.

n2.text:
To pick: how the page and the page count are entered.

A: the panel turns into two fields in the card, with Clear, Cancel and Save.
B: a sheet on a phone (a dialog on the web), as the start date is changed; a big page field with − and +.
C: the fields are always there, a stepper for the page; saved a second after the last change, as a series' steppers are.

All three: a number keyboard (inputmode numeric), 44 px targets or more, and a page above the page count refused before anything is saved.

picks.text:
Picked 2026-11-16:
The card: A (Change turns the panel into two fields in the card, with Clear, Cancel and Save).
The row: A (author and since when stay; the bar or "p. 88" is a third line).

n3.text:
To pick: where the page sits in the row.

A: author and since when stay; the bar or "p. 142" is a third line, where a series' bar is.
B: once there is a page, it takes the start date's place: "Susanna Clarke · p. 142", with the bar under it when there is a page count.

A book with no Progress looks as it does today in both.
